camera.perspective: 3D interior: brick wall behind is roughly fronto-parallel; a blue roller-conveyor ramp runs from the upper-left shelf (image ~ (260-720, 540)) down to the right and toward the camera, ending at a wooden floor/pallet at bottom-right (~x 1300-1920, y 990-1080). Ramp far edge image line approx (720,540)->(1460,990), slope ~31 deg below horizontal in the image; the near side rail runs approx (260,540)->(1220,1080) and leaves the frame at the bottom. Ceiling/wall junction near y~0-60 at top. No horizon visible.
